description: References to the United States, either as "United States" or abbreviated as "U.S." in legal, governmental, and official contexts.
Words appearing at the end of comparative phrases expressing degree or extent (e.g., "as much as possible", "as far as practicable").
Words appearing in the common phrase "take/taking into account" or "take/taking into consideration" used to express the inclusion or consideration of various factors in decision-making or analysis.
Words referring to temporal duration, periods, or moments in various technical and scientific contexts.
Modal verbs expressing ability, possibility, or capacity to perform actions.
Third-person singular present tense verbs in technical documentation, with "Gets" and "Sets" being JavaDoc accessor method documentation
